Floor markings, explained for first-time travelers
They often ask us about it
Floor markings are the quickest guide through the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways, so keep your eyes down and move with purpose. These lines and symbols show where to stand, where to wait, and where staff need a clear path for animals, carriers, and equipment.

Follow the markings without crowding the lane. Keep your pet close, your documents ready, and your voice low so the area stays calm. Handlers use humane methods and steady pacing, and the welcome team will move you forward when your place is clear. If you are traveling with Basil or another pet, stay with the marked path and avoid cutting across it.

For incident reporting, <<FACT F102>>. When a problem appears, tell the nearest staff member at once and keep the route open. Do not delay the report, because fast communication helps the team sort the issue before it spreads into a larger disruption.

Arrival pickup depends on the marked transfer area. <<FACT F095>>. Watch for the posted lane, keep your carrier secured, and wait where the markings place you so the handoff stays orderly. If you are meeting another traveler, stand aside from the main flow and do not block the passage.

If the markings seem unclear, pause and ask for direction instead of guessing. The desk will review concerns in a calm stepwise manner, and staff will give the next instruction without delay. For more help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
